provenance.method: HTTP GET with ?count=1 on each endpoint, one httpx.Client, one credential pair
provenance.note: Read-only. No object was created, modified or charged.

finding: Subscriptions is not enabled on this account. Endpoint-level authorisation, not a credential fault: seven endpoints returned 200 on the same client with the same credentials.

error_envelope_on_401.note: A bare string, not Razorpay's usual {"error": {"code": ..., "description": ...}} object. That is the product-not-enabled shape rather than the auth-failed shape.

consequences: Gate 1 is blocked behind an earlier step, not merely unanswered: there is no Subscription to charge, so whether 'Charge this now' offers a failure outcome cannot be asked.
D-033 branch (b) narrows: the Payment Links are real, the subscription context around them is synthetic. See A-020.
